items.description: Al-Magrun is a small town in the Benghazi district, located in the fertile plains of eastern Libya.
The Gurgi Mosque is one of Tripoli's most beautiful historic mosques, known for its fine marble and intricate tilework.
The Karamanli Mosque is an important religious site in Tripoli, founded during the Karamanli dynasty.
The Corinthia Hotel is a modern landmark in Tripoli, being one of the city's most prominent luxury hotels.
The Jamal Abdul Nasser Mosque is a major religious landmark in Tripoli, formerly a Catholic cathedral.
Tripoli Stadium is a major sports venue in the capital, hosting national and international football matches.
The Tibesti Hotel is a well-known landmark and luxury accommodation in the city of Benghazi.
The Zawiya Grand Mosque is a central religious site in the coastal city of Zawiya.
The Ras Lanuf Refinery is a critical industrial landmark in Libya's oil-rich Gulf of Sirte region.
The Al-Majidiya Mosque is a significant historic mosque in the Old City of Tripoli.
Wadi al-Hayat is a long valley in the Sahara Desert, historically home to the Garamantes civilization.
